papers.title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
papers.summary: HABIT-Bench evaluates whether LLM agent memory systems can infer implicit user habits from sparse dialogue evidence and apply them correctly across long-term interactions.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 78 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
papers.summary: Reasoning effort in generative models acts as a credence good where higher compute does not guarantee better instance-level results, and an escalation strategy from low effort improves cost-efficiency.
papers.insight: Vem com código aberto, fácil de experimentar.

papers.title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
papers.summary: RSI Arena demonstrates that autonomous AI agents can independently train and iteratively improve language models using human feedback, with most agents achieving preference gains in a second stage despite modest benchmark improvements.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.summary: Multiscale Policy Optimization improves long-horizon agent training by aligning credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 113 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 309 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization
papers.summary: LociArt enables precise local video stylization with region-style control and temporal consistency via a generative refinement network, automated dataset construction, and a dedicated benchmark.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 28 upvotes no Hugging Face.
